items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Chauncey Houghton from Baltimore later joined the band, and we went on a tour.

ctx.x: Because it was...Chauncey Houghton from Baltimore later joined the band, and we went on a tour. We played the Lafayette, then we went on tour to Baltimore, Washington, D.C., places like that. Then the band broke up.
Why did it break up? It couldn't get any more bookings?
